text: The trow is a Scottish folkloric figure. On the Shetland and Orkney islands, the trows were the most common kind of fairy. Their name probably comes from the Scandinavian trolls. Like the trolls, the trows disliked sunlight and were active at night. Unlike the trolls, the trows were not usually turned to stone by the sun.
